meta.titleHome: Pousada Recanto do Park | Penha, Santa Catarina
meta.descriptionHome: Cozy lodging in Penha, Brazil, just minutes from Beto Carrero World and the best beaches in the region. Book your stay.
meta.descriptionAccommodations: Discover the rooms and suites at Pousada Recanto do Park, in Penha, Brazil.

hero.title: Your getaway, steps from the magic
hero.subtitle: Just minutes from Beto Carrero World and the most beautiful beaches on the Santa Catarina coast.

about.title: Rest and adventure, side by side
about.body: Pousada Recanto do Park was made to be the perfect starting point for your Beto Carrero World and Penha beach getaway. A family-friendly atmosphere, comfort in every detail, and the most convenient location in the area.

location.title: Between the park and the sea
location.parkDescription: Latin America's largest theme park, right around the corner.
location.beachDescription: Armação, Gravatá and Prainha beaches waiting for you.

t2.name: João and family
